description: This file defines the GatewayPushSubscription enum with static methods to handle subscription and restart of push notifications via GatewayConnection.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to push notifications stream and executes onPush callback for each received push, respecting cancellation.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels the existing task and starts a new one to consume push notifications using the provided callback.
